title: M2 — basic image transforms
objective: Add exact rotations and horizontal/vertical reflection using the existing persistent layer/history service through UI and API.
context_summary: M2 is implemented on the working M1 history foundation and locally verified on the native M4 host plus automated exact-buffer, persistence, API and recovery evidence. All IDs and dependencies are local to this file. Exact mappings and evidence are documented in docs/engineering/m1-m2-results.md.

tasks.description: Define exact rotation and reflection layer semantics.
extra_context: Defined and tested in crates/lightwell-core/src/model.rs and render.rs: right maps (x,y) to (h-1-y,x), left to (y,w-1-x), horizontal mirror reverses x and vertical flip reverses y.

context_links.relevance: Defines this task's behavior, scope and observable acceptance.

acceptance_criteria: Start from a working saved-history/pixel-edit foundation; record that named baseline in the implementation evidence.
Define clockwise/counterclockwise quarter turns, Mirror horizontal and Flip vertical with input-stage pixel coordinates, output dimensions and exact integer mappings.
Specify layer composition and history semantics for transforms before/after pixel edits; four rotations and double reflections are identity mappings.
Fixtures distinguish all axes and operation order, including EXIF-mirrored sources, odd dimensions and non-square images.

steps: Write coordinate tables and expected buffers for asymmetric 3x2/5x3 images.
Walk pixel-before-transform and pixel-after-transform cases without introducing crop or interpolation.
expected_results: Fixtures distinguish all axes and operation order, including EXIF-mirrored sources, odd dimensions and non-square images.

tasks.description: Implement basic transforms through shared layer/history commands.
extra_context: Implemented as exact integer layer processors through EditorService transactions; asymmetric buffers, identities, pixel ordering, undo and reopen are tested without resampling.

steps: Evaluate every primitive and noncommuting combination against explicit expected buffers.

expected_results: Headless tests verify mappings, dimension swaps, compositions, historical snapshots, no source mutation and rejection without partial state.
